bibliographic.title: Twine Starter
bibliographic.author: Bharat Khiani
bibliographic.description:
This is a short tutorial on how to use twine to create passages, use variables and some basic macros.

If anyone has an IF idea and wants to prototype it real quick, i think checking out the story source file (.tws) will act as a guideline on how to use it.

The story source file can also be used as a template to get started with twine game development real quick.
